analyst_view.overall: Early view: Manchester City under Enzo Maresca have lost three league games in a row (Brighton, Aston Villa, Nottingham Forest), conceding inside the first 11 minutes each time. Xabi Alonso's Chelsea lost 1-0 at Sunderland and have scored once from open play in their last four league games, with Joao Pedro and Reece James out.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, with City expected to score 2.2. City's defence has been leaky, but their attack managed one goal across defeats to Brighton and Forest, and Chelsea have barely scored from open play. I lean a little lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. City will have more of the ball at home, and nothing in recent news shifts the corner count either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards, more for Chelsea. Chelsea picked up four bookings at Sunderland, which fits the number, so I stay with it until the referee is known.

shots.text: The numbers say 24 shots. City still create volume even while losing, and Chelsea's attack has been quiet, so the two balance out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target. Chelsea's lack of open-play threat with Joao Pedro out and City's poor finishing in recent defeats point slightly lower.
